福爾摩沙小導遊臺南 Tainan・中西區

湯德章紀念公園Tang Te-chang Memorial Park

認識臺南圓環和巴黎凱旋門的關係、公園的三個名字，以及律師湯德章的故事。

Learn how Paris inspired Tainan's roundabouts, why this park has had three names, and who Tang Te-chang was.

在臺南老城的中心，七條路交會在一座大圓環，中央是一片綠色公園。1900 年，長野純藏在巴黎看到凱旋門四周的街道，把這個想法帶回臺南。政府把最重要的建築蓋在圓環四周，今天它們成了文學館、消防史料館和美術館。公園換過三個名字。這裡先立著兒玉的石像，後來是孫中山的銅像。1947 年二二八事件中，律師湯德章協助維持臺南秩序。3 月 13 日，他在這裡被槍決。1998 年公園更名紀念他。每年 3 月 13 日，臺南以「正義與勇氣紀念日」紀念他。

In the heart of old Tainan, seven roads meet at a big roundabout with a green park in the middle. In 1900, Nagano Junzo saw the streets around the Arc de Triomphe in Paris and brought the idea home to Tainan. The government placed its most important buildings around the circle. Today they are museums of literature, firefighting and art. The park has carried three names. A stone statue of Kodama stood here first, then a bronze statue of Sun Yat-sen. During the February 28 Incident of 1947, the lawyer Tang Te-chang helped keep order in Tainan. On March 13, he was executed here. In 1998 the park was renamed for him. Every March 13, Tainan remembers him on the Day of Justice and Courage.

為什麼值得來

Why it matters & history
  1. 從巴黎來的圓環臺南為什麼有這麼多圓環？答案跟巴黎凱旋門有關。Why does Tainan have so many roundabouts? The answer involves the Arc de Triomphe.
  2. 公園的三個名字圓環中央的公園換過三個名字，每個名字都是一段歷史。The park at the center has carried three names, and each is a chapter of history.
  3. 律師湯德章這座公園提醒每一位經過的人：記得他，記得那段歷史。The park asks us to remember him, and that history, every time we pass.

認識景點

About the place

從巴黎來的圓環A roundabout from Paris

巴黎萬國博覽會：臺南市區計畫委員長野純藏參觀 1900 年巴黎博覽會，看到凱旋門四周的放射狀街道。 七條路交會：七條大路從這座圓環放射出去，是日治市區改正的軸心。 從防火空地到圓環：這裡原是一塊防火空地；1911 年的市區計畫把它變成圓環。 權力的宣示：州廳、合同廳舍、警察署都蓋在圓環四周，圓環也是統治權力的中心。

The Paris Exposition: Nagano Junzo, of the Tainan planning committee, saw the streets around the Arc de Triomphe at the 1900 Paris Exposition. Seven roads meet: Seven main roads radiate from this circle, the hub of the Japanese-era city plan. From firebreak to circle: It began as an open firebreak, and the 1911 city plan turned it into a roundabout. A statement of authority: The Prefectural Office, the He Tong Building and the Police Department all stood around the circle.

帝國的都市實驗場：日本本土的圓環不多，卻在臺南大方使用。日本遊客常覺得驚訝。

A city laboratory: Few Japanese cities have roundabouts, so Japanese visitors are often surprised to see so many in Tainan.

公園的三個名字Three names

大正公園：日治時期的正式名稱是大正公園；也有人稱它兒玉公園。 「石像」：1907 年中央立起總督兒玉源太郎的石雕像，老臺南人至今叫這裡「石像」。 失而復得的頭像：雕像戰後遺失；2015 年頭部在日軍舊官舍地板下被發現，現收藏於臺南市立博物館。 民生綠園：二戰後改名民生綠園，中央豎起孫中山銅像。

Taisho Park: Under Japanese rule it was officially Taisho Park, and some called it Kodama Park. The Stone Statue: In 1907 a stone statue of Governor-General Kodama Gentaro was set up here, so locals still call the spot the Stone Statue. A head found again: The statue was lost after the war. In 2015 its head was found under an old floor, and it is now in the Tainan City Museum. Min Sheng Green Park: After World War II it became Min Sheng Green Park, with a bronze statue of Dr. Sun Yat-sen.

湯德章紀念公園：1998 年更名，紀念在這裡罹難的律師湯德章。 公共藝術：孫中山銅像 2014 年被拉倒移除；2018 年底，莊靜雯的公共藝術《迎風》立在圓環中央。

Tang Te-chang Memorial Park: In 1998 it was renamed to honor Tang Te-chang, who died on this spot. Public art: The bronze statue came down in 2014, and a public artwork took the center in 2018.

律師湯德章Tang Te-chang, the lawyer

臺南出生：1907 年生於臺南，父親是日本人，母親是臺灣人，他跟隨母親姓湯。 從警察到律師：他先當警察，後來辭職到東京讀書，考取律師資格，再回臺南執業。 二二八事件：1947 年，政府以武力鎮壓各地抗議，全臺許多人因此失去生命。 維持秩序：事件中他被推舉協助維持臺南治安；被捕後沒有供出其他人的名字。

Born in Tainan: He was born in Tainan in 1907 to a Japanese father and a Taiwanese mother, and took his mother's family name. From police officer to lawyer: He first worked as a police officer, then studied in Tokyo, became a lawyer, and came home to Tainan. The February 28 Incident: In 1947, the government used force to put down protests, and many people across Taiwan lost their lives. Keeping the peace: He was chosen to help keep order in Tainan. After his arrest, he did not give away other people's names.

3 月 13 日：1947 年 3 月 13 日，他在這裡被槍決，享年 40 歲；後來法院判他無罪。 正義與勇氣：臺南把 3 月 13 日定為「正義與勇氣紀念日」；2022 年文學館前那段中正路改名湯德章大道。

March 13, 1947: On March 13, 1947, he was executed here at the age of 40. A court later declared him not guilty. Justice and courage: Tainan marks March 13 as the Day of Justice and Courage, and in 2022 named Tang Te-chang Avenue after him.

實景照片

Photos on site

圓環中央的雕塑 The sculpture in the middle

湯德章紀念公園中央高高的深色雕塑，是雕塑家莊靜雯的作品《迎風》，2018 年底立起。後面露出的圓頂，是原臺南州廳，也就是現在的國立臺灣文學館。

The tall dark sculpture in the middle of Tang Te-chang Memorial Park is called Facing the Wind. It was set up at the end of 2018. Behind it is the dome of the old Prefectural Office, now the National Museum of Taiwan Literature.
